steps.en: Build the server from source — community binaries are no longer published
steps.zh: 从源码构建服务端——社区预编译二进制已不再发布

steps.en: Start it on an empty directory of your choice
steps.zh: 选一个空目录把它跑起来

steps.en: Serves the S3 API on :9000 and an embedded web console
steps.zh: 在 :9000 提供 S3 API 与内嵌 Web 控制台

steps.en: Point any S3 client at it and start writing objects
steps.zh: 任意 S3 客户端指向它就能建桶、读写对象
steps.code: mc alias set local http://localhost:9000 minioadmin minioadmin

steps.en: Stores objects in the erasure-coded MinIO layout that a maintained fork can still read
steps.zh: 用纠删码的 MinIO 布局落盘，维护中的 fork 仍能直接读

value.en: The self-hosted S3 server a generation of stacks was built on — still runnable from source, but every future fix now comes from you or a fork
value.zh: 一代自建栈的 S3 底座——仍可从源码运行，但以后每个修复都得靠你自己或某个 fork

sources: https://github.com/minio/minio#readme (THIS REPOSITORY IS NO LONGER MAINTAINED; source-only distribution, no pre-compiled community binaries)
https://github.com/minio/minio#install-from-source (go install github.com/minio/minio@latest; minio server PATH; default minioadmin:minioadmin; console on :9000)
https://github.com/minio/minio#test-using-minio-client-mc (mc alias set local http://localhost:9000 minioadmin minioadmin)
